title: Offcanvas
description: Makes its host a trigger: a click slides a panel with a title and body in from the left or right edge over a backdrop, and a second click, the backdrop or the close button takes it away. It applies to any clickable element, so it names no host.

offcanvasTitle.description: The panel's heading. Named offcanvas-title, not title, so the trigger keeps its own native title tooltip; heading= is read too.

offcanvasContent.description: The panel's body (HTML). description= is read too.

position.description: The edge the panel slides in from; start is left, end is right.

setup: <button x-offcanvas offcanvas-title="Filters" position="right">Open from the right</button>

_metadata.derivedFrom: src/wb-viewmodels/overlay.js offcanvas() — every property here is one the behavior reads
